sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00 in what should be a comfortable fixture on paper. Sandbach are top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and arrive off a loss, but their underlying form remains strong with seven wins from their last six outings before that setback. Alsager Town prop up the division with just 4 points and are in freefall, having won only once all season and losing their last four games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a stern test away at Dawley Town, a fixture that could prove pivotal in the title race given Stafford's pursuit of leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a battle between two sides challenging for automatic promotion spots, with both looking to bounce back from recent defeats. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter featuring two sides in mixed form. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in a clash between teams occupying the middle rankings. Widnes Town's visit to Brereton Social pits two struggling sides against each other, with Widnes bottom of the league on just 2 points. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Market Drayton Town in a lower-table affair. Shawbury United are in deep trouble facing Barnton; Shawbury have lost their last five consecutive matches. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in another lower-mid-table fixture. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a fixture between teams fighting to climb away from the bottom half. Wednesday evening sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a midweek clash between two sides seeking to arrest difficult spells.
